qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strategic UK logistics big-box portfolio; sub-4% ROIC fails the 12% hurdle, and index-linked rent reviews are contractually capped at 2-4% p.a., lagging inflation surges while mega-tenants possess heavy bargaining power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 3.8%, REJECT). Prime UK big-box logistics facilities fail capital efficiency hurdles with unlevered portfolio yields of ~5% and ROIC < 4%. RPI/CPI rent reviews are capped at 2-4% p.a., lagging severe inflation, while tenant concentration caps pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Tritax Big Box manages a £5B+ UK logistics portfolio with ~11-year WAULT let to blue-chip tenants including Amazon, Morrisons, and DHL. Portfolio Net Initial Yield hovers at 4.75-5.5%, generating multi-year GAAP ROIC of 3.5-4.0% (sub-12% hurdle). Net debt/EBITDA is ~7.3x-8.2x with interest coverage of ~4.4x. While modern logistics space benefits from e-commerce tailwinds, ~50% of indexed leases have 2-4% annual caps that severely lag inflationary peaks, and development pipeline yields (~6-7%) do not elevate corporate ROIC to compounder levels.
